name: zcode-agent-cluster
description: ZCAC — multi-agent coding cluster orchestration on top of the ZCode Agent Runtime (task graph, scheduler, agent pool, review loop, git worktree isolation).

zcacModel.title: Default model
zcacModel.description: Logical model id providerId/modelId[@reasoningLevel] used by cluster workers

zcacIsolation.title: Workspace isolation
zcacIsolation.description: shared (workers share the workspace) or worktree (each write task gets its own git worktree, merged back on success)

zcacConcurrency.title: Max concurrent tasks
zcacConcurrency.description: Global task concurrency for the cluster scheduler
